_comment: The scope of the capability matrix: which headers must be listed on capabilities.rst, and which are
能力矩阵的覆盖范围：哪些 header 必须出现在 capabilities.rst 里，哪些是刻意还没列的。
`covered_roots` is the families the matrix is about -- control, estimation and motion. `hal/` and
`driver/` are excluded on purpose: they are contracts and host stubs, not capabilities, and they are
already covered by claim rows and the strict-header gate.
`unlisted` is a ratchet, not permission. Every header under a covered root must be either listed on
the page or named here, and the count is printed on every gate run. A new header must be one or the
other, so a capability cannot arrive with no diagnostic channel, no admission path and no boundary
row -- which is what the matrix exists to prevent. Reducing this list is the work; adding to it
requires a reason in the same commit.
